title: Even the seagulls are against me in GTA 6 #gta6 #shorts
description: My own GTA 6 gameplay from a Vice City Beach police chase. (Champs Network)

scenes.say: Keep your eyes on the seagull.
I'm flying down Vice City Beach with the cops right behind me.
And then this seagull decides it's his moment.
Direct hit. He did not care about my wanted level.
Who's the bigger threat, the cops or the seagulls?
